title: P1-A AI streaming chat scrollback resume 20ms

phases.label: Start streaming from the tail-followed position
Target performs deterministic programmatic scrollback while streaming continues
Target resumes tail-follow while streaming continues
Keep the page foreground-active after the stream completes

sop: Load the P1-A target and confirm the visible audit state shows ready=true and idle_ms is increasing before the run starts.
Confirm baseline_id, scenario_mode=scrollback-resume, history_messages=160, stream_tokens=800, and token_interval_ms=20.
Press Enter only after the history is mounted and has been idle for at least 2 seconds.
Do not manually scroll or interact during capture; scrollback and resume are deterministic target actions.
Keep the Chrome window foreground-active for the full 45 second capture window.
